limitations: No assertion about arbitrary observables or finite moments of the original unbounded Cauchy coordinate.
Boundary parameters are excluded, and the critical limits are taken after the fixed-parameter large-horizon limit.
The normalized third cumulant coefficient is not a uniform normal-approximation error bound.
An earlier equivalent exact third-order coefficient in broader inner-function literature remains possible.

scientific_integrity.independence: Only self-review and independent supporting arithmetic/quadrature code; no independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_integrity.prior_theory: Invariant Cauchy law, mixing, Lyapunov exponent, general inner-function covariance and central limit results are antecedents and are not claimed as new.
scientific_integrity.result: Analytically proved for the specified Cauchy-stationary generalized Boole maps, fixed interior parameters and bounded rational Cayley observable; the third-order rate and endpoint asymmetry are the claimed addition.

title: Exact cubic fluctuation law for the Cauchy-preserving generalized Boole map
